page.overview:
Who is Churi?

Divination|dislikes=Bitter Things|status=Unknown|firstgame=Street Fighter V (Scrapped)}}

Churi (チュリ?) is the character from the 11th broadcast.

Churi is a man resembling Juri, including having a Feng Shui Engine that he can use for divination. He loves Chun-Li and wears clothes similar to his idol, wishing to become a female fighter.
